system.description: You create a vacuum of air around a willing creature in range. Until the beginning of your next turn. All melee and ranged attacks, targeting the affected creature, must roll 1d20 when they declare the attack. On a roll of 8 or greater, the attack is diverted to another random creature in range. Assign a number to each creature within the attacks range, excluding the original target, and the GM randomly decides which number is the new target.
